items.title: Omni Announce Deluxe Deluxe For Its 10th Anniversary: Hear New Song “Coliseum”
items.summary: Omni burst out of Atlanta a decade ago with Deluxe , a debut album that placed them at the forefront of a post-punk resurgence. Now the band is putting out a 10th anniversary deluxe Deluxe to mark the occasion. The two-disc set includes the 10 original album tracks and their demos plus the 2017 singles "Fever Bass" and "Thesis" and two previously unreleased songs, "Loud Talking" and "Coliseum." The group gave their first reunion performance at the Back 2 The Bay fest on Aug. 13, and they were supposed to give their second on Saturday at the New West Coast Festival, a one-day fest in Salt Lake City. The Drin’s tunes live furtively in fetid underground bunkers, where their ear-wormy melodies bounce off muck and concrete.
